en.headline: Observatory issues Strong Monsoon Signal for easterly winds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Strong Monsoon Signal at 20:00, warning of mean winds exceeding 40 km/h from the east with occasional gale-force gusts.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Strong Monsoon Signal at 20:00 on Saturday, stating that strong winds with a mean speed exceeding 40 kilometres per hour are expected from the east. Gusts will occasionally reach gale force.

The Observatory advised people not well sheltered from the east to take precautions against strong gusty winds and to bring flower pots and other loose objects indoors. Those planning water sports or operations at sea should take special care against high winds and rough sea conditions, which are particularly rough over offshore waters.
The signal remains in force until further notice. The Observatory said the warning was dispatched at 20:00 HKT.

zh.headline: 天文台發出強烈季候風信號 東風強風間中烈風
zh.dek: 香港天文台晚上8時發出強烈季候風信號，預料本港吹東風，平均風速超過每小時40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
body: 香港天文台於星期六晚上8時發出強烈季候風信號，表示本港吹強風，平均風速每小時超過40公里，風向為東風，陣風間中會達烈風程度。
天文台提醒，如果居所未能有效抵禦東風，市民應採取預防措施，把花盆及其他容易被吹走的物件搬入室內。打算進行水上活動或海上作業的人士亦應特別小心，防範大風大浪，離岸海域風浪尤其大。
信號現正生效，直至另行通知。天文台指有關天氣稿於晚上8時發出。
